subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Alter
solution:
The correct answer is **Transform**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alter:** change in character or composition, typically in a comparatively small but significant way.
 
• **Transform: **to change somebody/something completely.
 
• Thus, the correct synonym of **Alter** is **Transform**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Retain: **to keep or continue to have something; not to lose.
 
• **Preserve: **to keep something safe or in good condition.
 
• **Beautify:** improve the appearance of something.
